title: TD01
tagline: Gather, build, ship and defend a mountain village.

credits.work: Engine, icons, fonts and sound · all creators

back: A small mountain village needs your help to survive.
Explore the surrounding land and gather what your people need.
Turn your discoveries into defenses that protect the village.
Prepare together as danger approaches along the roads.
Build a place worth coming home to, then stand together to defend it.
